text: 10月27日，遭香港证监会点名股权高度集中的上市公司——新吉奥房车的股价盘中闪崩，收盘大跌超33%，而该股年内累计最高涨幅一度接近15倍。今年以来，香港证监会已公示17家同类港股公司，这类个股筹码锁定超过九成，流通盘稀少，暴涨暴跌频发。港交所发言人表示，港交所一向负责公众持股量监管，但这与证监会股权集中风险提示属于两套独立的监管体系，评判逻辑不同。对于投资者来说，公司的单一合规指标无法充分反映流动性隐患，仍需多维度评估风险。
text_en: On October 27, shares of New Gonow RV, a listed company named by the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) for highly concentrated shareholding, plunged intraday and closed down more than 33%, after having risen by nearly 15 times at their peak this year. Since the start of this year, the SFC has publicly flagged 17 similar Hong Kong-listed companies; in such stocks, more than 90% of shares are locked up, leaving a thin free float and frequent sharp swings. An HKEX spokesperson said HKEX has always been responsible for regulating public float, but this and the SFC's concentration risk alerts belong to two separate regulatory systems with different assessment logic. For investors, a single compliance indicator cannot fully reflect liquidity risks, and risk still needs to be assessed from multiple dimensions.
